roles.title: Consulting Lead
roles.summary: Advising Swiss enterprises on data engineering and data governance, and on the organisational side of putting AI to work.

roles.title: Cloud & AI Platforms Specialist
roles.summary: Drove Azure adoption and AI innovation across the territory — modernising infrastructure, unifying data platforms, and scoping cloud-native, analytics and AI workloads with account teams and partners.

roles.title: Data & AI Principal
roles.summary: Worked with global key accounts in staffing, services, cybersecurity and process manufacturing to turn data and AI on Azure into business outcomes — bridging executives, IT leaders and subject-matter experts, and designing enterprise data platforms rather than debating AI in the abstract.

roles.title: Lecturer for Digital Corporate Culture
roles.summary: Taught Digital Corporate Culture on the Dipl. Digital Innovation Manager NDS HF programme: how leadership values shift in a digital future, which role models a digital strategy actually needs, and how mission statements survive contact with it.

roles.title: Independent Consultant, Human-Centered Design
roles.summary: Self-employed work with clients in regulated industries — healthcare and finance — sharpening internal and client-facing value propositions through human-centered design. Built a coaching cycle to measurably improve team agility, and delivered Design Thinking, Lean and Agile training. The essays below come from this period.

roles.title: Content Lead, Design Thinking GSA · Consultant TA CH
roles.summary: Led Design Thinking content for EY's advisory practices across Germany, Switzerland and Austria. Lead coach on EY's Innovation Journey, training around a thousand colleagues; co-founded EY's global Design Thinking community. Method lead on transformation programmes including the redesign of a DAX-30 automotive group's corporate finance function.

roles.title: Consultant, EMEIA Financial Services Advisory — Risk
roles.summary: Compliance and operational risk for financial services clients: financial PMO for a global insurer's audit co-sourcing, FINMA-compliant regulatory audit of a bank's compliance function, and an operational-risk event recording system built to EBA ITS 2017/01.

roles.title: Intern, EMEIA Financial Services Advisory — Risk
roles.summary: Supported the regulatory audit of a Swiss bank's compliance function and a new target operating model for a Swiss private bank's risk function.

roles.title: Student Assistant, Institute for Business Ethics
roles.summary: Helped build an executive programme on corporate social responsibility.

roles.title: Research Assistant, Institute of Technology Management
roles.summary: Literature analysis, qualitative and quantitative research design, and editing articles for journal review alongside professors and doctoral students.

roles.title: Working Student, Institute for Systemic Management and Public Governance
Luthier's Assistant
roles.summary: Assistant to the violin maker Almut Schubert: setting up and dismantling instruments, preparing them to be played, and handling minor repairs. Later ran my own repair customers and reorganised the workshop's stock and order process.
